artist.name: Parvati
artist.bio: Parvati is a New Delhi electronic music project. The 2022 album 'Naksha' set pitched-down Baul-style vocals, flute and classical-style singing over organic house, moving into straight house on its closing tracks 'Shikaari' and 'Nikas'.

eras.sound: Organic house built from flute and Baul-style vocals

press.title: Parvati Offers Thumping Organic House With 'Naksha'
